dialogues.speaker: Chaplina
dialogues.text: Hehe, he's the greatest hunter on the Snezhnayan tundra! He can hunt down absolutely anything.

dialogues.speaker: Chaplina
dialogues.text: Back when we were all helpless against the biting cold, he swore up and down, "I'll find us a place where we can stay warm far away from the city!"

dialogues.speaker: Chaplina
dialogues.text: Nobody believed him back then, but guess what? He pulled it off.
